title: A phone call
setting: You call your friend Selin, from your Turkish course, one evening. Her mother answers the phone.
goal: Ask for someone on the phone, leave a message, and make plans with a friend.

cast.name: Nermin Hanım
cast.why: Your friend's mother, older and new to you: *siz*. Many young people call her *teyze*, aunt, still with *siz*.

cast.name: Selin
cast.why: Selin is your friend from the course: *sen*.

nodes.note: *Alo* answers the phone; *buyurun* invites you to speak.

turn.prompt: Say good evening, and ask to speak to Selin.

replies.en: Good evening. Could I speak to Selin?
Good evening. Could you put Selin on?
Good evening. Could you put Selin on?
Good evening. It's Selin.
replies.why: *Ben Selin* says you **are** Selin. Ask for her: *Selin'le görüşebilir miyim?*

nodes.tr: Selin şu an evde yok, markete gitti. Kim arıyor?
nodes.en: Selin isn't home right now, she's gone to the shop. Who's calling?

turn.prompt: Say you're Selin's friend from the course. You might also ask whether she's Selin's mother.

replies.en: I'm Selin's friend from the course.

replies.tr: Ben Selin'in kurstaki arkadaşıyım. Siz annesi misiniz?
replies.en: I'm Selin's friend from the course. Are you her mother?
You're Selin's friend from the course.
replies.why: *Arkadaşısınız* says **she** is Selin's friend. About yourself: *arkadaşıyım*.

nodes.tr: Evet, annesiyim. Memnun oldum! Selin sizden çok bahsediyor.
nodes.en: Yes, I'm her mother. Nice to meet you! Selin talks about you a lot.

turn.prompt: Say you're pleased to meet her too.

replies.en: Nice to meet you too.

replies.tr: Ben de memnun oldum. Selin de sizden çok bahsediyor.
replies.en: Nice to meet you too. Selin talks about you a lot too.

replies.tr: Ben de memnun oldum. Selin de senden çok bahsediyor.
replies.en: Nice to meet you too. Selin talks about you a lot too.

nodes.tr: Bir mesajınız var mı? Selin gelince söylerim.
nodes.en: Do you have a message? I'll tell Selin when she gets back.

turn.prompt: Ask her to tell Selin to call you back. Or say there's no need: you'll call again tomorrow.

replies.en: Yes, could you tell her to call me?
Yes, could you tell her to call me?

replies.tr: Hayır, gerek yok. Yarın tekrar ararım.
replies.en: No, there's no need. I'll call again tomorrow.
Yes, could you tell her to call you?
replies.why: *Sizi aramasını* asks Selin to call **her mother**. You want her to call you: *beni aramasını*.

nodes.tr: Beni mi? Ama ben evdeyim! Selin'in sizi aramasını mı istiyorsunuz?
nodes.en: Me? But I'm at home! You want Selin to call you?

turn.prompt: Say yes, sorry: you'd like her to call you.

replies.tr: Evet, pardon. Beni aramasını söyler misiniz?
replies.en: Yes, sorry. Could you tell her to call me?
Yes, yes! I'd like her to call me, please.

nodes.tr: Tabii, söylerim. Numaranız Selin'de var mı?
nodes.en: Of course, I'll tell her. Does Selin have your number?

replies.en: Yes, she does. Thank you very much.
Yes, she does. Thank you.
Yes, she does. Thanks.

nodes.tr: Aa, kapı çaldı! Selin geldi galiba. Bir dakika, veriyorum.
nodes.en: Oh, there's the door! I think Selin's back. One moment, I'll put her on.
nodes.note: On the phone *vermek*, to give, is to hand the phone over: *Selin'i verir misiniz?*, *Veriyorum*.

replies.en: Of course, I'll wait.
Of course, thank you. I'll wait.
Of course, thanks. I'll wait.

nodes.tr: Peki, nasıl isterseniz. Aa, kapı çaldı! Selin geldi galiba. Bir dakika, veriyorum.
nodes.en: All right, as you like. Oh, there's the door! I think Selin's back. One moment, I'll put her on.

replies.en: Of course, I'll wait.
Of course, thank you. I'll wait.
Of course, thanks. I'll wait.

nodes.tr: Alo, selam! Annemle tanıştın mı? Ne haber?
nodes.en: Hello, hi! Did you meet my mum? What's up?

turn.prompt: Say hi, and ask whether she's free on Saturday.

replies.tr: Selam! Evet, annen çok tatlı. Cumartesi boş musun?
replies.en: Hi! Yes, your mum's lovely. Are you free on Saturday?
accept: Selam! Evet, tanıştık. Cumartesi boş musun?

replies.tr: Selam! Evet, anneniz çok tatlı. Cumartesi boş musunuz?
replies.en: Hi! Yes, your mum's lovely. Are you free on Saturday?
Hi! Am I free on Saturday?
replies.why: *Boş muyum?* asks whether **you** are free. Ask Selin: *Boş musun?*

react.en: How should I know? You tell me!

nodes.tr: Cumartesi mi? Öğlene kadar çalışıyorum, ama akşam boşum. Ne yapalım?
nodes.en: Saturday? I work until noon, but I'm free in the evening. What shall we do?

turn.prompt: Suggest the cinema, or dinner out.

replies.tr: Sinemaya gidelim mi? Yeni bir film başladı.
replies.en: Shall we go to the cinema? A new film has just come out.
Shall we have dinner in a restaurant?
Are you working on Saturday?
replies.why: She's just said she works until noon (*öğlene kadar*) and is free in the evening.

react.en: Until noon, I said. I'm free in the evening!

nodes.tr: Olur! Saat sekizdeki seansa gidelim. Sinemanın önünde buluşalım mı?
nodes.en: Sure! Let's go to the eight o'clock showing. Shall we meet in front of the cinema?

turn.prompt: Agree, and say you'll be there at a quarter to eight.

replies.tr: Tamam! Sekize çeyrek kala orada olacağım.
replies.en: Okay! I'll be there at a quarter to eight.
accept: Olur, sekize çeyrek kala orada olacağım.

replies.en: Okay, it's a deal. See you!

replies.tr: Tamam! Sekize çeyrek kala orada olacaksın.
replies.en: Okay! You'll be there at a quarter to eight.
replies.why: *Olacaksın* is about Selin. About yourself: *orada olacağım*.

react.tr: Ben mi? Peki, ama sen de gel!
react.en: Me? Fine, but you come too!

nodes.tr: Süper fikir! Kadıköy'de çok güzel bir balıkçı biliyorum. Sekizde orada olalım mı?
nodes.en: Great idea! I know a lovely fish restaurant in Kadıköy. Shall we be there at eight?

turn.prompt: Agree, or say you don't like fish.

replies.en: Okay, I'll be there at eight.

replies.tr: Aslında balık sevmiyorum. Başka bir yer olur mu?
replies.en: Actually, I don't like fish. Could we go somewhere else?
accept: Balık sevmiyorum, başka bir yer olur mu?
Ben balık sevmem. Başka bir yer olur mu?

nodes.tr: Hiç sorun değil! O zaman Moda'daki köfteciye gidelim, orası da çok iyi.
nodes.en: No problem at all! Then let's go to the meatball place in Moda, that's very good too.

replies.en: Great, I'll be there at eight.
Sure, I love köfte!

nodes.tr: Süper! Cumartesi görüşürüz. Annemin de selamı var!
nodes.en: Great! See you on Saturday. And my mum says hi!
nodes.note: *Annemin selamı var*, “my mother sends her greetings”, often ends a call. You answer: *Sen de benden selam söyle*, say hi from me too.
nodes.end: You've made plans with Selin for Saturday evening.

phrases.note: On the phone *vermek*, to give, is to hand the phone to someone.

phrases.en: Could you tell her to call me?
phrases.note: A request passed on: `-mA` with a possessive, then *söylemek*.

phrases.en: One moment, I'll put her on.
